maya: quick sync: customer asks = per-model cost, route error slices, trace headers. need MVP cut.

frank: prioritize cost + errors. tracing headers can be opt-in.

elaine: support requires top-10 error signatures and example request IDs to repro. 7d samples ok.

samir: infra note: implement header passthrough + sampling 0.5% by default; full trace ingest = phase 2.

carla: cost compute must be pre-aggregated (emit per-request metatags + nightly rollups) to meet perf SLAs.

maya: proposed MVP: dashboards (cost per 1k tokens by model & route, error-rate by route, latency p95), cost API, error table with samples, opt-in trace headers. 30d agg retention. canary -> beta orgs for 1 week.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window: 1961300000 -> 1961303600

frank: owners: Samir=ingest/rollups, Carla=cost pipeline, Elaine=UX, Maya=PM+rollout. I'll create cards.

maya: gating for GA: dashboard p95 < 1s, cost numbers reconcile with billing in canary, privacy redaction validated. closing thread.
